name: L-System Garden
desc: A lush wind-swept garden of L-system plants — ferns, weeds and flowering sprigs grown from branching rewrite rules, filling the frame with luminous foliage and colored blossoms that sway on incommensurate breezes and reseed new species each section.

density.doc: garden lushness — plant count (3-6) + foliage/leaf richness

wind.doc: sway amplitude of the breeze (tips move most)
